Create one finished production-quality 2D side-view THREE KINGDOMS tower-defense BACKGROUND PLATE, landscape 16:9, ideally 2048x1152, fully painted edge to edge.

Input image 1 is ONLY an art-style reference: thick expressive dark outlines, richly painted chunky wood and stone, Chinese historical cartoon game aesthetic. Do not copy its characters, text, interface, devices, or enclosed castle rooms.
Input image 2 is the environment edit target: preserve its readable three horizontal traversable tiers, hand-painted quality and alternating side stairs, but REPLACE the setting according to the following precise setting.

THE USER'S IMPORTANT SETTING:
This is an OUTDOOR battlefield around a Chinese walled town. There are exactly three elevated outdoor terraces with different identities, NOT three enclosed rooms, NOT an interior castle, NOT a stacked apartment.
TOP TIER: Liu Bei's outdoor command camp on the highest terrace. A clearly recognizable substantial ivory canvas military command tent, green trim, green military pennants, open dark entrance at the FAR RIGHT end of this upper lane. The tent occupies the rightmost 14% of the composition and marks the defended destination. Leave the long central lane completely clear. Weathered timber hanging beams and sparse pergola supports can provide overhead trap attachment points without closing off the sky. Green wooded hills and a soft blue-gray cloudy sky behind this camp. No soldiers or characters.
MIDDLE TIER: an open-air street INSIDE the town walls. Muted Chinese tiled-roof houses, market awnings, recessed shuttered stalls, stone retaining walls and timber brackets behind the traversable lane. It must read as a town street exposed to air, not a basement corridor. A clearly readable closed side gate / reinforced town entrance at the far right is the future middle-tier enemy entry. Keep stalls in the background; the walking foreground is uncluttered.
BOTTOM TIER: rough earthen approach OUTSIDE the town wall, tufts of grass, worn stone, recessed heavy gray city masonry, some distant siege smoke visible through the left opening. Open left edge is the main enemy approach and retreat. Keep the horizontal traversable lane clear; no placed barricades, no traps, no warriors. Ambient rubble stays below or behind the walking surface.

GAMEPLAY COMPOSITION MUST BE PRECISE:
Keep all three walking surface contact lines straight and horizontal, near y=31%, y=59%, y=87% of image height. Across x=10%-89% each has enough continuous clear width for eight freely placeable units; no painted grid, sockets, circles or unit silhouettes.
Connect BOTTOM to MIDDLE with a broad wooden/stone staircase at the FAR RIGHT edge. Connect MIDDLE to TOP with a wooden stair or switchback rock stair at the FAR LEFT edge. Stair ends must visibly touch the adjacent walkable surfaces. The top-left stair landing doubles as the future upper-tier reinforcement approach.
Raised earthen terraces supported by city retaining masonry and timber beams make the vertical geography plausible. Keep generous open air and shallow scenic depth behind each path. Readable stone wall surfaces and OVERHEAD TIMBER attachment beams are available for wall and ceiling-type traps, especially below terrace overhangs, while the upper camp has open crossbeams. Do not fill lanes with these supports.
Player needs to read an S-shaped progression: bottom left -> bottom right stairs -> middle left stairs -> top right command tent. No fourth platform. No ladder or stair crossing the center of the battlefield.

ART DIRECTION:
Match the supplied game art's detailed but crisp brushwork, black-brown contour outlines, warm weathered ochre earth and wooden platforms, cool desaturated gray stone, green camp accents, restrained orange lantern light. Daylight after rain / late afternoon, cinematic yet highly legible. Detail concentrated around edges and backdrops; quieter, flatter-value gameplay lanes. High polish consistent with the existing zhugongkuaipao assets, not photoreal, not 3D, not cute pastel minimalism.
ABSOLUTELY NO UI, no title, no readable writing, no Chinese characters, no numbers, no captions, no arrows, no watermark, no human figures, no enemies, no deployed weapons, no coins. This is the empty reusable level background, not an illustrated game screenshot.
